---
title: "Analysis 07: Calculate Phenotype Correlations"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
```

# Inputs
```{r}
strain_means <- readRDS("data/processed/phenotypes/strain_means.rds")
tox_data <- data.table::fread("data/processed/tox_data/con_metadata.csv")
```

# Calculate correlations

```{r}
library(psych)

strain_means_pivot <- strain_means %>%
  dplyr::mutate(StrainMean = as.numeric(StrainMean_NormLength)) %>%
  dplyr::select(strain, drug, StrainMean) %>%
  tidyr::spread(key = drug, value = StrainMean)

# # Convert to matrix with strain as rownames
strain_means_pivot_matrix <- as.matrix(strain_means_pivot[, -1])
rownames(strain_means_pivot_matrix) <- strain_means_pivot$strain

# Calculate phenotype correlations with NA's
pheno_corr_all <- psych::corr.test(
  strain_means_pivot_matrix,
  use = "pairwise",
  adjust = "bonferroni",
  method = "spearman"
)

# Save the pivoted strain means for future use
saveRDS(strain_means_pivot_matrix, "data/processed/phenotypes/strain_means_matrix.rds")

# Extract correlation coefficients and p-values
# Save outputs
saveRDS(pheno_corr_all, "data/processed/phenotypes/pheno_corr_all.Rds")

pheno_corr_all
```

# Calculate average correlation across all toxicants

```{r}
# Extract correlation matrix
corr_coef <- pheno_corr_all$r

# Convert to long format for analysis
corr_coef_df <- as_tibble(corr_coef, rownames = "trait1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-trait1, names_to = "trait2", values_to = "r_value")

# Calculate the average correlation (excluding self-correlations)
pheno_corr_all_avg <- corr_coef_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(trait1 != trait2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_r = mean(r_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r = sd(r_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

pheno_corr_all_avg

# Save the overall average correlation summary
saveRDS(pheno_corr_all_avg, "data/processed/phenotypes/pheno_corr_all_avg.Rds")
```

# Calculate within- and between-group correlation summaries

Create unique toxicant pairs with their Use class and MoA annotations.

```{r}
# Get unique pairwise correlations (upper triangle only, excluding diagonal)
# This avoids double counting pairs (A-B and B-A) and self-correlations (A-A)
get_unique_pairs <- function(cor_matrix, tox_metadata) {
  # Convert correlation matrix to long format
  cor_df <- as_tibble(cor_matrix, rownames = "trait1") %>%
    pivot_longer(-trait1, names_to = "trait2", values_to = "r_value") %>%
    # Keep only unique pairs (where trait1 < trait2 alphabetically)
    dplyr::filter(trait1 < trait2)

  # Add metadata for trait1
  cor_df <- cor_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      tox_metadata %>% dplyr::select(drug, big_class, moa_class),
      by = c("trait1" = "drug")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Use1 = big_class, MoA1 = moa_class)

  # Add metadata for trait2
  cor_df <- cor_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      tox_metadata %>% dplyr::select(drug, big_class, moa_class),
      by = c("trait2" = "drug")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Use2 = big_class, MoA2 = moa_class)

  return(cor_df)
}

# Get unique pairs with annotations
tox_pair_df <- get_unique_pairs(
  cor_matrix = pheno_corr_all$r,
  tox_metadata = tox_data
)

# Verify the number of unique pairs: n*(n-1)/2 where n = number of toxicants
n_tox <- nrow(tox_data %>% dplyr::filter(big_class != "Control"))
expected_pairs <- n_tox * (n_tox - 1) / 2
actual_pairs <- nrow(tox_pair_df)
cat("Expected pairs:", expected_pairs, "\n")
cat("Actual pairs:", actual_pairs, "\n")

tox_pair_df
```

Calculate within- and between-group correlation summaries for Use class and MoA.

```{r}
# Calculate Use class correlation summary
use_class_cor_summary <- tox_pair_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = ifelse(Use1 == Use2, "within", "between")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    mean_r = round(mean(r_value, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_r = round(sd(r_value, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_type = "Use")

use_class_cor_summary

# Calculate MoA class correlation summary
moa_class_cor_summary <- tox_pair_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(comparison = ifelse(MoA1 == MoA2, "within", "between")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    mean_r = round(mean(r_value, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_r = round(sd(r_value, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_type = "MoA")

moa_class_cor_summary

# Combine summaries
class_correlation_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  use_class_cor_summary,
  moa_class_cor_summary
) %>%
  dplyr::select(group_type, comparison, n_pairs, mean_r, sd_r)

class_correlation_summary
```

Save the correlation summaries.

```{r}
# Save detailed pairwise data
data.table::fwrite(
  tox_pair_df,
  "data/processed/phenotypes/tox_condition_pair_correlations.csv"
)

# Save class correlation summary
data.table::fwrite(
  class_correlation_summary,
  "data/processed/phenotypes/class_correlation_summary.csv"
)
```
